page.content:
Geoffrey's history that launched the medieval Arthur industry.

How Historia Regum Britanniae connects

  • Creator: Geoffrey of Monmouth — Geoffrey wrote the Historia Regum Britanniae.
  • Topic: Arthurian legend — Geoffrey's history made Arthur a European literary king.
  • Work: Le Morte Darthur — Geoffrey's Latin king stands behind the romance Malory later Englishing.

What is Historia Regum Britanniae?

The History of the Kings of Britain traces Britain from Brutus to Cadwallader and inserts Arthur as a conqueror-king, the seed of the later romance explosion.

Key threads lead to Geoffrey of Monmouth, Arthurian legend and Le Morte Darthur.
